mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions out at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 70 degrees.

In city news, please note that all city buildings will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, Thursday refuse and recycling pickup will be pushed back to Friday, November 27, and the Verona Recycling Center will be closed both days.

For your schedule, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is a full slate of trivia nights at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report from November 2, officers responded to a call on West End Circle where a 48-year-old local man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Butter Pecan. If you are looking for a treat, the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will serve customers until 10:00 PM.
